entities.summary: Sandra Anne Brondello is an Australian professional basketball coach and former professional basketball player. She is the head coach of the Australian women's national team and the inaugural head coach of the Toronto Tempo of the Women's National Basketball Association (WNBA). Brondello played in Australia, Germany and the WNBA before retiring to become a coach. The 5’7” Brondello is one of Australia's all-time best shooting guards. She played on Australia's "Opals" national team at four Summer Olympics, has coached the team at two more, and won three medals as a player and one bronze medal as a coach.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As a four-time Olympic player and one-time coach of the Australian women's national team, Brondello has had a significant impact on Australian basketball, contributing to three medals as a player and one bronze medal as a coach. Her coaching career has also paved the way for future generations of Australian female basketball players.
